gates.requirement: Every accepted envelope and event passes the v2 contract and replay is deterministic.
Signatures, encryption, key rotation, ACLs, audit chaining and replay protection are tested.
Postgres integration, migrations, tenant isolation, backups and restore pass against a real service.
A hidden holdout with public hashes and independent runners meets accuracy and freshness thresholds.
The declared reference profile survives million-scale load, concurrency, restart and corruption recovery.
The deployment is reproducible and health, metrics, alerts, backup and rollback are verified.
A minimum-duration soak against a real deployment meets the availability and latency SLOs, and cost is measured from provider billing or metered infrastructure rather than a local proxy.
SDK, schemas, pagination, typed errors and compatibility policy are documented and tested.
